ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, on the left side is a vertical wall marked with diagonal lines, and at the bottom is a horizontal ground marked with diagonal lines. Sphere A is on the left side, close to and in contact with the smooth vertical wall; hemisphere B is on the right side, placed flat on the rough horizontal ground. The curved surfaces of A and B are in contact at an oblique position, and the two have equal radii. Then reason: Let the angle between the line connecting the centers of A and B and the horizontal plane be α. Since the wall is smooth, A is subjected to its own gravity G_A, the horizontal supporting force of the wall on A, and the supporting force N of B on A along the direction of the line connecting the centers. A is in equilibrium in the vertical direction, so N sinα = G_A, hence N = G_A / sinα. For B, the force exerted by A on B is in the opposite direction along the line connecting the centers, and the magnitude of its horizontal component is N cosα. B is stationary in the horizontal direction, so the magnitude of the friction force exerted by the ground on B is f = N cosα = G_A cotα. After moving B slightly to the left, A is still against the wall, and the center of B is closer to directly below the center of A. The line connecting the centers of A and B is closer to the vertical direction, so α increases, cotα decreases, and therefore f decreases.

method.method_draft: 先从图中读出：A为左侧靠光滑竖直墙的圆球，B为右侧放在粗糙水平地面上的半圆球，A与B在斜向接触点相切，且两者半径相等。由题文读出：墙面光滑、A和B接触面光滑，系统前后均静止，B向左稍移。设A、B圆心连线与水平面的夹角为α。对A受力分析：A受重力G_A、墙面对A的水平支持力、B对A沿圆心连线方向的支持力N。竖直平衡给出 N sinα = G_A，因此N = G_A/sinα。对B而言，A对B的作用力水平分量为 N cosα，地面对B的静摩擦力大小必须平衡该水平分量，所以 f = N cosα = G_A cotα。B向左移动后，由图中几何关系可知A仍贴墙，B圆心更靠近A圆心的正下方，A、B圆心连线变得更接近竖直，即α增大。因此cotα减小，B受到地面的摩擦力变小。
